name: Tsuki to Odorou
source:
Teru Hinomoto, a boy afflicted with a rare illness that prevents him from being exposed to sunlight, meets Luna, the last surviving vampire.

Luna dreams of changing humanity’s perception of vampires and earning its acceptance, so she spends every night helping those in need.

But her efforts have yet to bear fruit, and the city is filled with rumors that paint vampires as creatures to be feared.

"Come play the night with me!"

Drawn in by her invitation, Teru begins spending his nights with Luna, helping her aid others.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4821650/Dance_with_the_Moon/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
身患无法沐浴阳光的罕见怪病的少年阳之下辉，邂逅了世间仅存的最后一名吸血鬼少女露娜。

露娜梦想着改变人类对吸血鬼的偏见、赢得人类社会的接纳，因此每晚都在街头奔走，向需要帮助的人们伸出援手。

然而她的努力迟迟未能结出硕果，整座城市依旧充斥着将吸血鬼描绘成可怖怪物的流言蜚语。

“来和我一起畅游黑夜吧！”

受她热情邀约的吸引，辉开始与露娜共度一个个夜晚，协助她为他人排忧解难。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4821650/Dance_with_the_Moon/]Steam[/url]]
